title: COP21 → COP31 — Commitments & Achievements
summary: Explore COP21–COP31 commitments, documented implementation and independently measured environmental outcomes. Conference years never substitute for scientific assessments; COP31 outcomes remain pending official adoption.
insight: Use the conference selector to compare agreements and remaining gaps. An optional progress marker links comparable regional observations to the shared planetary-boundaries chart, without changing its scientific values or attributing recovery to a COP.

ui.title: COP21 → COP31 — Commitments & Achievements
ui.independence: No COP conference took place in 2020. Conference selection is independent of scientific assessments and Fever years.
ui.insufficient: Insufficient evidence for global boundary improvement
ui.markerLegend: Green hollow marker: comparable regional observation; not a global boundary ratio or COP achievement. Scientific fills and thresholds stay unchanged.
ui.evidenceLegend: Evidence types: measurements · policy commitments · implementation records · projections (none plotted). Marker position is illustrative, not normalized from its measurement.
ui.latestContext: Latest verified observations in this package, checked 2026-11-10; shared across conferences, not historical COP-year measurements or causal attribution.
ui.translationNote: Source summaries and scientific caveats are retained in English. Scientific interface and SVG labels follow the selected language.
